query: with pending as ( select pending.* from unnest($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::bigint[], $4::bigint[]) as pending(id, referrer, views, thumbnail_views) join files on files.id = pending.id ), totals as ( update files set views = files.views + per_file.views, thumbnail_views = files.thumbnail_views + per_file.thumbnail_views from (select id, sum(views)::bigint as views, sum(thumbnail_views)::bigint as thumbnail_views from pending group by id) as per_file where files.id = per_file.id ) insert into file_referrer_views (file_id, referrer, views, thumbnail_views) select id, referrer, sum(views)::bigint, sum(thumbnail_views)::bigint from pending group by 1, 2 on conflict (file_id, referrer) do update set views = file_referrer_views.views + excluded.views, thumbnail_views = file_referrer_views.thumbnail_views + excluded.thumbnail_views
